blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur — With a tight local budget and backed by out-of-pocket contributions from municipal workers, the Municipality of Kumalarang in Zamboanga del Sur province is making its fourth bid for top honors at the 2026 National Literacy Awards (NLA). National evaluators from the Department of Education’s (DepEd) Literacy Coordinating Council (LCC) visited the town this week to validate its grassroots programs, placing Kumalarang among the top five national contenders in the fourth- to fifth-class municipality category. The biennial awards recognize local government units (LGUs), non-government organizations, and higher education institutions for initiatives that help universalize literacy and […]...
